reference.title: Validation diagnostics
reference.shortdesc: Every problem code opend validate, the previewer and the hosted build report, what it means and how to fix it.

section.title: Reading a diagnostic
section.codeblock: topics/install.dita:14:9: error [broken-link] link target not found: setup.dita
section.p: That is the file, line and column, the severity, the code and a message. An error fails validation and stops a hosted build from publishing. A warning does not, unless you validate with --strict. Codes are stable, so tools can filter on them.

strow.stentry: error
opend.config.yaml is not in the folder you validated.
Pass the docs root, or create the file.
error
The config is not valid YAML, or a field breaks its rules. The hosted build also reports it when release is not a version number.
Follow the message, which names the field. See .
error
The buildFilter file does not exist.
Fix the path, which is relative to the docs root.
error
The DITAVAL root is not <val>, or a prop has an unknown action.
Use include, exclude, flag or passthrough.
error
The theme file does not exist.
Fix the path.
error
Two publications have the same file name, so only one could be downloaded at /pdf/<name>.pdf.
Rename one bookmap.
error
preview-contexts.yaml is not valid YAML, or a reader is malformed, for example without a version. Reported by the CLI only.
See .
error
A topic, map or DITAVAL file is not well-formed XML.
Look at the line and column: an unclosed tag, a stray & or < (write & and <, or use CDATA), or an unknown entity.
error
The root map, or a map a mapref points at, does not exist, or a mapref has no usable href.
Fix the path.
error
Maps reference each other in a loop. The message shows the chain.
Remove one mapref.
error
A topicref points at a file that does not exist, or that is not a .dita or .xml file.
Fix the href.
warning
A topicref points at an external URL, or has a format other than dita. It is skipped.
Link to external pages from a topic with xref instead.
warning
A navigation entry has neither an href nor a navtitle, so it has nothing to show.
Add one, or use topicgroup to group without a heading.
error
A file a map references has no topic root element.
Make the root a topic type, or point the map elsewhere.
error
A topic's root element has no id.
Add one; references use it.
error
Two elements in one topic share an id.
Rename one, and update references to it.
warning
An element is outside the supported subset. It renders as a plain block.
Use a supported element: see .
warning
A topic file is in no map, and no published topic reuses content from it. It is usually forgotten.
Add it to a map, reuse a chunk from it, or delete it.
error
A filtering attribute has a value that is not declared in opend.config.yaml, or the attribute has no declared values at all. Readers never see that content.
Fix the typo, or declare the value under attributes.
error
A release token is not a version or range. Readers never see that content.
error
A link points outside the docs root, or at a file, topic or element that does not exist.
Fix the href. Same-file links take #topic-id/element-id.
warning
A link points at a topic that is not in the site navigation, so every reader sees plain text.
Add the target to the site map (with toc="no" to keep it unlisted), or remove the link.
error
An image file, or the file a key for an image names, does not exist.
Fix the path, relative to the topic or map.
warning for keyref, error for conkeyref
The key is not defined in the keyspace of the map publishing this topic. A keyref falls back to the element's own content; a conkeyref pulls nothing.
Define the key, or pull the shared key map into this map or bookmap with a mapref.
error
A conref is not of the form file#topic/element, its file, topic or element does not exist, or a conkeyref key has no local href.
Check the ids in the chunks file.
error
Content references pull each other in a loop. The message shows the chain.
Break the loop.
warning
An element pulls a chunk of a different element type, such as a p pulling a note. The chunk is used as it is.
Make the referencing element the same type as the chunk.
warning
The element uses conrefend or conaction. Only the start element is pulled.
Reference each element separately, or wrap the range in one element with an id.
error
A resourceid lacks appname (the host app) or appid (the context key).
Give both.
error
Two topics claim the same app and key without conditions, so the second could never be shown.
Add conditions to tell them apart, or use a different key.
error
help-contexts.yaml is not valid YAML, does not match the expected shape, or has a bad route pattern.
See the help-contexts.yaml reference.
error
A route or default in help-contexts.yaml maps to a key that no topic declares, nor any parent of it.
Add a resourceid for the key, or fix the key.

ul.li: In the terminal, from opend validate and opend preview.
In the previewer's banner, and at /_opend/diagnostics.json.
As GitHub workflow annotations with --format github.
On the hosted platform: a failing push shows a failed opend/build commit status with the first errors, and the full list is in the build's record from the admin API.
